title: Finland - 2026.08.03
notes: Finland faces a delicate balancing act as the government pushes ahead with spending restraint to contain a deficit projected at 3.6 percent of GDP in 2026, even as unemployment remains among the highest in the European Union. With GDP growth forecast at just 0.7 percent and nearly 376,000 people out of work, critics argue that austerity risks smothering a recovery that households have barely felt. The debate over timing, fairness, and economic strategy is shaping up as one of the most consequential domestic arguments in Helsinki in years.
